4. Check your work before submitting.

MARKING SCHEME
====

1. A — Practise Drawing ● Elements and principles of 2- dimensional Art ● linear perspective ● o with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

2. D — Practise Collage ● type of collage; single-media and mixed media collage ● characteristic with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

3. A — Practise Painting ● wash technique ● painting sceneries ● painting composition using brus with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

4. A — Practise Graphic Design 2.2 Fabric decoration: Tie and dye 2.3 Fabric decoration: Batik 3 with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

5. D — Practise Fabric Decoration: Tie and Dye ● Tie and dye ● technique- ● Materials . with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

6. A — Practise Fabric Decoration: Batik. 2 colours ● Batik - Concept - Crackled effect - textur with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

7. A — Practise Pottery 3.2 Sculpture 3.3 Macramé 3.4 Jewellery and Ornamentation 3.5 Art Apprec with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

8. C — Practise Graphic Design ● Trademark ● An educational/ social/ /advertisement poster. with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

9. D — Prepare muscles and reduce injury risk

10. A — Red, blue, and yellow

11. C — The speed of the music

12. C — Practise Painting 1.3 Collage 2.0 Multimedia Arts 2.1 Graphic Design 2.2 Fabric decoratio with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

13. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Sculpture- Carving ● Concepts of carving (materials- wood/stone/clay/, and tools; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

14. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Macramé; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

15. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Jewellery and Ornamentation 3.5 Art Appreciation Page 15 of 51 1 STRAND 1.0: PIC; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

16. (4 marks)
